title: Technology and Trust

article.heading: TRANSPARENT SYSTEMS
article.paragraph: People trust a system more when they understand how it makes important decisions.

article.heading: CLEAR EXPLANATIONS
article.paragraph: Clear explanations turn complex tools into services that people can use responsibly.

article.heading: TRANSPARENT SYSTEMS
article.paragraph: Trust grows when a service explains its limits as clearly as its benefits. People need a way to question an automated decision when the result affects their lives. Transparent design shows which information was used and which information was left out. A reliable tool should make it possible to correct an error without starting over. Clear language can reduce fear when people are asked to try an unfamiliar system. Accountability matters because every useful technology still reflects human choices. The best explanation is not the longest one but the one that helps a person act. Trust becomes stronger when users can see how feedback changes the product.

sentence_interpretations.sentence: Transparent design shows which information was used and which information was left out.

sentence_interpretations.sentence: A reliable tool should make it possible to correct an error without starting over.
sentence_interpretations.translation: 신뢰할 수 있는 도구는 처음부터 다시 시작하지 않고 오류를 수정할 수 있게 해야 합니다.

sentence_interpretations.sentence: Clear language can reduce fear when people are asked to try an unfamiliar system.
sentence_interpretations.translation: 명확한 언어는 사람들이 익숙하지 않은 시스템을 사용해 보라는 요청을 받을 때 두려움을 줄입니다.

sentence_interpretations.sentence: Accountability matters because every useful technology still reflects human choices.
sentence_interpretations.translation: 유용한 기술도 인간의 선택을 반영하기 때문에 책임성이 중요합니다.

sentence_interpretations.sentence: The best explanation is not the longest one but the one that helps a person act.
sentence_interpretations.translation: 가장 좋은 설명은 가장 긴 설명이 아니라 사람이 행동할 수 있게 하는 설명입니다.

sentence_interpretations.sentence: Trust becomes stronger when users can see how feedback changes the product.
sentence_interpretations.translation: 사용자가 피드백이 제품을 어떻게 바꾸는지 볼 수 있을 때 신뢰가 더 강해집니다.
